plan.title: bug(check): consumer gate references missing verify:orphan-active task

narratives.Description: Vendored consumers can hit task: Task "verify:orphan-active" does not exist when running task deft:check. The consumer check graph lists verify:orphan-active while the optional verify Taskfile include can silently omit tasks/verify.yml, leaving the gate unresolvable. This blocks green Deft pre-commit even when application tests pass.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`task deft:check` fails in a vendored consumer because the check graph invokes `verify:orphan-active`, but that task is not defined in the installed task catalog.

## Environment

- Engine: `@deftai/directive-core@0.87.0`
- Host: macOS / zsh
- Consumer uses `.deft/core/Taskfile.yml` under the `deft:` namespace

## Reproduction

```sh
task deft:check
```

The gate enumerates the task catalog and exits with:

```text
task: Task "verify:orphan-active" does not exist
task: Failed to run task "deft:check": ... exit status 200
```

## Expected

The consumer-safe check graph only invokes tasks shipped in the same payload, or defines `verify:orphan-active` before wiring it into `check`.

## Impact

Consumer projects cannot obtain a green mandatory Deft pre-commit gate even when their application unit tests, typecheck, build, and architecture checks pass.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer maintainer, I want task deft:check to only invoke tasks that exist in the installed deposit (or fail with a clear deposit-repair message), so that incomplete optional includes cannot hard-break the mandatory pre-commit gate.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Add a deposit/check integrity contract that every CONSUMER_CHECK_GATES entry resolves against the shipped Taskfile includes (content package + framework CI). 2) Fail loud when check-graph namespaces (especially verify) are missing instead of optional silent omit leading to go-task does-not-exist. 3) Optional doctor probe that consumer deposits can list verify:orphan-active and the consumer gate set. 4) Regression fixture with incomplete deposit missing tasks/verify.yml. 5) CHANGELOG #3070.
